proposed_capability: Preserve at-most-once Fairy Dust proposals while allowing a fresh alternate source and keeping pending native readback scoped to its actor.
player_save_control_impact: Existing native idle, save, scene and actor gates are preserved. Test fixtures issue no external effects.
expected_outcome: Another actor can progress independently. A spent action cannot hide a freshly observed alternative or be replayed. Completion accepts a fresh capture independent of both admission frames.
negative_tests: Other actor readback cannot clear the original attempt.
Replayed readback from either admission capture cannot close the attempt.
Repeated opportunity IDs cannot be submitted again, even if an adapter reports no effect.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact EA interaction IDs, live submission, inventory telemetry, and timing still require a Windows trial under #171.
